name: animated-form
title: Animated Form
description: Config-driven contact form with validation for text, phone, select, textarea, and checkbox fields

changelog.summary: Added form motion: error messages slide or fade in, fields shake on error, success ticks draw in, live character counters on the name, email and message fields, and a staggered entrance. All respect reduced motion. Fields and dropdowns default to a 6px (rounded-md) radius.
Added configurable color, border-radius, and duration controls.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Page background color around the form.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color for the form heading and field labels.

props.name: inputBackgroundColor
props.description: Background color for inputs, textarea, and select controls.

props.name: fieldBorderColor
props.description: Default border color for form controls.

props.name: inputRoundedness
props.description: Border radius for inputs, dropdowns and the submit button in pixels. Defaults to 6 (rounded-md).

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition duration for control focus and button effects in seconds.

props.name: errorAnimation
props.description: How an error message enters under its field: slides open, fades in, or appears at once.

props.name: shakeOnError
props.description: Fields with an error give a short shake when Submit is pressed.

props.name: showSuccessTick
props.description: A tick draws itself inside a field once its value is valid.

props.name: showCounter
props.description: Name, email and message fields show a live character count that warms up near the limit.

props.name: staggerEntrance
props.description: Fields fade up one after another when the form first appears.
